instructions: Answer any three out of the remaining five questions.
Assume any suitable data wherever required and justify the same.

questions.label: 1a
questions.text: Mention four characteristics of big data and explain in detail.

questions.label: 1b
questions.text: Explain Shuffle & Sort phase and Reducer phase in Map Reduce.

questions.label: 1c
questions.text: Demonstrate how business problems have been successfully solved faster, cheaper and more effectively considering NoSQL Google's Bigtable case study. Also illustrate the business drivers and the findings in it.

questions.label: 1d
questions.text: List down all six constraints that must be satisfied for representing a stream by buckets using DGIM algorithm with examples.

questions.label: 2a
questions.text:
The project manager at XYZ Ltd., Ms. Meera, is responsible for maintaining details of all active projects. She has organized the project information in the following table:

| Project Id | Project Name | Budget | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CRM Implementation | 120000 | In Progress |
| 2 | Cloud Infrastructure | 180000 | Completed |
| 3 | Network Upgrade | 60000 | Not Started |
| 4 | E-Commerce Platform | 220000 | Completed |
| 5 | Data Analytics | 90000 | In Progress |

i) Create a Data frame in R for the above project data and display the output.

ii) Ms. Meera has recently approved 2 new projects and wants to add their information. The new projects are as follows:

| Project Id | Project Name | Budget | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | UX Research | 160000 | Not Started |
| 7 | Cloud Integration | 190000 | Not Started |

Update the Data frame to include the new projects and demonstrate the final output.

questions.label: 2b
questions.text: Write a short note on variations of NoSQL architectural patterns.

questions.label: 3a
questions.text: Suppose the stream is S = \{10, 12, 8, 15, 6, 9, 14, 7\}. Let hash functions h(x) = 5x + 11 mod 32 for some a and b, treat result as a 5-bit binary integer. Show how the Flajolet-Martin algorithm will estimate the number of distinct elements in this stream.

questions.label: 3b
questions.text: Explain natural join and grouping and aggregation relational algebraic operation using MapReduce.

questions.label: 4a
questions.text:
Write a map reduce pseudo code to solve the word count problem. Apply map reduce working on the following document.

"Big data is powerful. Big data drives decisions."

questions.label: 4b
questions.text: With a neat sketch, explain the architecture of the data-stream management system.

questions.label: 5a
questions.text: Determine communities for the given social network graph using Girvan-Newman algorithm.
questions.note: Graph in the paper, edges: A-B, A-C, B-D, C-D, B-E, D-E.

questions.label: 5b
questions.text: List and discuss various types of data structures in R.

questions.label: 6a
questions.text: Describe the components of Hadoop ecosystem with the help of a diagram.

questions.label: 6b
questions.text: What is recommendation system? How is classification algorithm used in recommendation system?
